**sdd/issue-259-d2/spec**

**What**: sdd-spec delta for the D2 net-tip-effect redesign (judgment-day R3 CRITICAL #945, owner ruling #955 Fork A + net-parity with 5 binding conditions C1-C5). Amended spec.md REQs + 2 surgical design.md edits. Artifact store: openspec (file-based).

**Where (files+sections)**:
- `openspec/changes/issue-259-d2/spec.md`: REQ-D2-3, REQ-D2-6(b), REQ-D2-10, REQ-D2-10a amended; REQ-D2-16 NEW + C5 provenance/doctrine block added before Out-of-scope.
- `openspec/changes/issue-259-d2/design.md`: §3.6 documentary-invariant REVISED (C2); §15.5 exit-contract paragraph gained the NEW tree-keyed⟺FAIL-SHA bidirectional coherence-guard bullet (C4). Owner prose otherwise untouched. tasks.md NOT touched.

**Amended/new REQs**:
- REQ-D2-3: "one [FAIL-SHA] per offending merge" → "per auto-revertible offending merge (≥1 un-exempted tree-keyed failure), deduped to the newest net-present carrier per payload signature" + newest-carrier dedup scenario.
- REQ-D2-6(b): rebound exit to failCount (any class), decoupled from FAIL-SHA count; exit-1-with-zero-FAIL-SHA now LEGITIMATE; NEW bidirectional guard "≥1 un-exempted tree-keyed failure ⟺ ≥1 [FAIL-SHA]"; replaced the stale "zero-offenders-on-code-1=uncomputable" scenario with 3 scenarios (legit-zero + two bidirectional exit-2).
- REQ-D2-10: removed stale path-scoped `P∩D=∅` (names it stale/replaced by whole-commit diff-inversion normDiff), added net-tip anchor (net-parity ≤0), strengthened re-introduction scenario to cover revert-of-revert.
- REQ-D2-10a: same P∩D→normDiff/net language on fail-closed; added BINDING [FAIL-SHA] class filter (only tree-keyed adrPresence/diffSize emit; issueLink/memoryPresence MUST NOT) + A9 class-filter scenario.
- REQ-D2-16 (NEW): net-tip-effect invariant with BOUNDED claim (C2) — net-absent under EXACT-diff normDiff accounting, NOT "not on disk"; rename+modify → sign 0 → fail-closed → stays counted.

**How C1-C5 landed**:
- C1 (fixture bar): REQ-D2-16 A7 scenario = the CRITICAL forge O,R,R2 where R carries its OWN memoryPresence-absent failure → isOffender(R)=true → R2 crowned → mutation bar REDDENS against MERGED PR2 pairwise predicate (not just eff4560); A8 liveness. Explicitly "UNPROVEN without this exact forge."
- C2 (bounded claim): REQ-D2-16 bounded-claim paragraph + design §3.6 invariant revised to stronger-but-bounded with the bound written; "proves not on disk" flagged as 8th hollow-mechanism instance.
- C3 (range asymmetry): 4 named REQ-D2-16 scenarios — off-by-one both ends, offender at edge, merge-HEAD live re-add reaches checks, revert-cleanup-at-HEAD sees offender behind it (directional resolved-skip vs full-window reverter-skip).
- C4 (dissolved guard replaced): REQ-D2-6(b) bidirectional tree-keyed⟺FAIL-SHA + two exit-2 fixtures; design §15.5 gained the bullet stating the guard (design previously only rebound crash-check to failCount).
- C5 (process+doctrine): REQ-D2-16 "Amendment provenance & doctrine" block — merged-surface reopen of resolution.mjs on feature/v2.0.0; A5 semantic FLIP "O resolved"→"O NOT-resolved" named for PR body; doctrine "merged ≠ correct; merged = passed the gates we had"; diagnosis LOCAL predicate answering GLOBAL question.

**Learned**: Only intentional `P∩D` reference left in spec is the one naming it stale. Gate/Chain PR table deliberately NOT modified (owner planning prose; PR mapping for the amendment is the tasks phase's job). Grounded in resolution.mjs (isResolvedAt 185-193, normDiff 133-139) and brain-audit.mjs (reverterSkipLine 145-168, [FAIL-SHA] 496, crossCheckExit 205-208).
